bull.b: Oracle’s large installed enterprise base and long-standing support contracts create durable recurring revenue and strong renewal economics. This installed footprint reduces customer acquisition cost, enables steady subscription upsells into cloud and SaaS, and supports multi-year revenue predictability.

bull.t: Sustained revenue growth and improving margins
bull.b: Multi-year top-line expansion with concurrent net-margin improvement shows durable business model leverage. Consistent revenue growth across software, applications and cloud infrastructure indicates structural demand and improved earnings conversion that can fund reinvestment and sustain competitive positioning.

bull.t: Huge forward visibility and AI-driven demand (RPO)
bull.b: A $638B RPO backlog provides unusually long revenue visibility and underpins multiyear cash flow expectations, particularly from large AI infrastructure contracts. This contracted pipeline supports capacity planning, predictable revenue recognition and durable demand for OCI and database services tied to AI workloads.

bear.b: A materially larger debt burden constrains financial flexibility, raises interest expense sensitivity, and increases refinancing risk. Elevated leverage limits the company’s ability to absorb shocks, execute opportunistic M&A, or repurchase shares without additional financing or dilutive equity issuance.

bear.t: Deeply negative free cash flow recently
bear.b: Negative free cash flow after heavy investment means operating cash less available for discretionary uses. Reliance on external financing to fund growth undermines cash-generation quality, increases funding costs and elevates execution risk if cash conversion fails to normalize as new sites ramp.

bear.t: Very large near-term CapEx and margin pressure
bear.b: Aggressive data-center buildout requires massive near-term capital and will compress gross margins until utilization and contractual revenue scale. Realizing attractive long-term returns depends on sustained high utilization, customer renewals and successful cost pass-throughs amid rising competition for AI capacity.
